paper_title: New Limit on Dark Photon Kinetic Mixing in the 0.2-1.2 $\boldsymbolμ$eV Mass Range From the Dark E-Field Radio Experiment
notes: Paper reports a new measured 95% CL exclusion on dark photon kinetic mixing epsilon from the Dark E-Field Radio experiment (UC Davis), spanning 50-300 MHz (0.21-1.24 ueV). The actual limit (Fig. 11) is highly frequency-dependent, ranging between 6e-15 and 6e-13, tracking shielded-room resonant mode structure. No numerical table is provided, so the emitted two points are a conservative flat envelope at the WORST-case (weakest) value 6e-13 across the stated mass range; the true limit reaches down to 6e-15 at favorable frequencies. Local DM density fixed at 0.45 GeV/cm^3 (~450 TeV/m^3).
